# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Resume Evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not mentioned | ❌ |

## Mandatory Match Percentage

The posting has 10 numbered items, but item 8 bundles five tools, so the score can be counted two ways:

- **By numbered requirement:** 9 of 10 = **90%**
- **By individual skill:** 13 of 14 = **~92.9%**

Both clear the 85% threshold, so the counting choice doesn't change the result.

## Outcome

✅ **Proceed.** The candidate meets the 85% mandatory threshold.

**Gap to note:** GraphQL is the only missing mandatory skill. It may be worth probing in an interview or flagging as a training need.

**Nice-to-have (for reference only):** The resume doesn't mention Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, or public speaking. As instructed, this doesn't affect the outcome.
